children: Shares of Avalon Technologies Ltd. will be in focus on Thursday, November 26, after global brokerage firm HSBC initiated coverage on the electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company with a 'Buy' recommendation and a price target of ₹2,250 per share.
The target price implies a potential upside of nearly 33% from the stock's closing level on Wednesday, November 25.

In its initiation note, HSBC described Avalon Technologies as a leading EMS player with a diversified product portfolio, customer base and manufacturing footprint. The brokerage believes the company's presence across multiple segments and production locations positions it to capitalise on emerging growth opportunities.

HSBC highlighted semiconductor equipment as one of the key growth drivers, noting that several of these opportunities are still at an early stage and are poised for substantial expansion. The brokerage believes these emerging segments could support the company's growth trajectory over the coming years.

The brokerage also pointed to Avalon's strong financial metrics, including an EBITDA margin of over 12%, return on capital employed (ROCE) of more than 24% and an asset turnover ratio of 10.7 times in the second quarter of FY27.

Despite the stock's sharp rally, HSBC believes there is further room for upside. Avalon Technologies shares have gained around 90% year-to-date in 2026, outperforming the Nifty, which has declined about 3% over the same period.

The brokerage said that consensus earnings per share (EPS) estimates for FY28 and FY29 have also been revised upwards by around 30% and 45%, respectively. According to HSBC, the stock's current valuation does not fully reflect the company's growth potential, leaving room for further re-rating.

Earlier in September, Nomura had retained its 'Buy' rating on Avalon Technologies and raised its price target to ₹2,767.32 from ₹2,211.24, indicating its positive view on the company's growth prospects.
According to the analyst coverage data, 10 of the 20 analysts tracking the stock have a 'Buy' recommendation. Four analysts have a 'Hold' rating, while the remaining six have a 'Sell' recommendation.
Avalon Technologies shares ended 0.89% higher at ₹1,689.40 on Wednesday, November 25. The stock has gained more than 90% so far in 2026.

title: Avalon Tech shares can rally another 33% after nearly doubling in 2026, HSBC says
